source.purpose: Distinguish valid PR required-check evidence from manual workflow_dispatch runs and prevent skipped path-filter checks from blocking promotion PRs
source.cost_quota: free public official documentation; no API key or paid credit
source.reliability_limits: Documents GitHub required-check behavior; does not itself prove that a repository's current branch protection requires a particular check. Confirm local auto-merge-gate configuration and the actual latest PR check runs.

learning.title: Manual workflow_dispatch cannot satisfy required PR status checks
learning.claim: GitHub Actions jobs triggered by workflow_dispatch do not satisfy required pull-request status checks; required checks skipped by pull_request path filters can remain pending and block merging.
learning.decision: PR_REQUIRED_CHECK_EVENT_GATE: if a required test check must appear on a promotion-only PR, run it on an eligible pull_request event and ensure promotion paths are not excluded (or provide an always-running lightweight required job). workflow_dispatch is diagnostic only and must not be claimed to satisfy a required PR status check. Verify actual latest-head check and job names before any merge; do not bypass required checks.
learning.next_measurement: For existing PR #141, update the approved PR test trigger to cover knowledge/promotions/** or use a safe always-running required job; capture latest head SHA, pull_request-triggered test run ID, test job success, and promotion read-back before merging. Keep Evaluate-mode archive safety correction separate; PayoutLens excluded.
failure_history: 2026-10-10 PR #141 promotion-only changes did not trigger worker-orchestration-tests pull_request.paths; manual workflow_dispatch was previously suggested but is not a valid substitute for required PR check.
fallback_history: Until the trigger is fixed, keep PR unmerged and mark required-check evidence missing. Do not fabricate success or turn off the gate.
